fusions.name: Breech Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy round from a breech-loader that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour.

fusions.name: Buckshot Spread
fusions.desc: Fires 6 pellets in a wide spread; each one deals 4 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rifled Barrel
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Chambered Round
fusions.desc: Each kill chambers a fresh round: your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
